title: Enterprise contract commitments: SSO/SAML, RBAC granularity & pricing experiment
creator: Elena Park
description: Objective: Define a pragmatic, negotiable set of contract commitments and packaging experiments for SSO/SAML and RBAC requirements that frequently appear in enterprise RFPs and security questionnaires. Deliverables: (1) a tiered packaging proposal that maps security commitments to price/commitment levels, (2) negotiation playbook and sample contract language, (3) top-20 security questionnaire answers and a handoff to Sales/Legal, and (4) engineering tickets & estimates for committed scope. Motivation: enterprise prospects request SAML-based SSO, fine-grained RBAC, audit log retention guarantees, and contractual language in security questionnaires. We need standard packaging and fallback positions to accelerate closes without overcommitting engineering resources.
acceptance_criteria: Tiered packaging doc published and approved by Legal and Sales
Template contract clauses for SSO/SAML and RBAC included in contract playbook
Top-20 security questionnaire answers drafted and stored in Confluence for Sales reuse
Engineering tickets created for committed features with rough estimates and prioritized roadmap placement
Pilot agreement signed with 1-2 existing enterprise customers to validate pricing and SLA commitments
decisions: Adopt a three-tier enterprise packaging model: Enterprise Basic (SAML metadata + SCIM optional), Enterprise Plus (SAML + SCIM + role hierarchy RBAC), and Enterprise Isolated (VPC + dedicated SLA + extended audit retention)
SAML support will be delivered as SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows; support for IdP metadata upload and test mode in first release
RBAC initial commitment is role-based access at org/team/service level (not resource-level ABAC) — deeper granular RBAC to be scoped as paid Professional Services or roadmap item
Audit log retention commitments: 90 days for Enterprise Plus, 365 days as add-on for Enterprise Isolated

Security questionnaire canonical answers will include our standard mitigations (SOC2 roadmap, encryption at rest/in transit, KMS integration) and an explicit fallback indicating higher commitments available under Private deployments
Pricing experiment: A pilot discount band (10–20%) for customers who accept Enterprise Plus commitments with a 12-month revenue commit. Document price anchors and walk-away thresholds.
